knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A result covers the place sampled. It does not clear other areas, and it needs competent interpretation.
The plan, laboratory and custody, with competent interpretation, are the basis for relying on a result.

practicalCriteria: From a fictional result sheet, the learner checks for the plan, laboratory, custody record and coverage, and marks each as present or missing. Pass: all four checks are completed.
The learner writes a note asking for competent interpretation of a result with a missing custody record. Pass: the note states the result is unverified.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: A result has no documented plan, laboratory or custody record.
A sample is proposed to be collected by an unqualified person.
